items.context: I remember playing Wolfenstein 3D, a game that looked more like MS-DOS than an early version of Minecraft
items.text: Wolfenstein 3D was a big deal on 1992 PCs, and it was one of the early shareware hits too.

items.author: qwilman.bsky.social
items.context:
ZZT! An old DOS game where making/sharing your own games was a huge core component. museumofzzt.com
link card: Museum of ZZT
items.text: ZZT was great for that: the editor was built right in, so anyone could make a game and share it. Nice that it is still preserved online.
